subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'leaving'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the blank is 'leaving'.
 
• The word 'leaving' means '**go away from**'.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 'leaving'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Let's look at the other options.
 
 
• Settling- *resolve or reach an agreement about (an argument or problem).*
 
• Reckoning- *the action or process of calculating or estimating something.*
 
• Keeping- *the action or fact of owning, maintaining, or protecting something.*
